headline: It's Happening: Rival App Stores Are Coming to Google Play Next Week
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high across all criteria. It combines major tech giant drama (Google vs. Epic) with a fundamental, practical change for every Android user, making it both highly clickable and mainstream. The ability to spin this into numerous formats—from explainers and listicles ('Top 5 App Stores to Try') to quick tips—gives it maximum content potential for our publication.
summary: Following the withdrawal of a proposed settlement with Epic Games, Google will now be required to list third-party app stores for download directly within the Google Play Store, with the change taking effect next week.

source_articles.title: Third-party app stores coming to Google Play next week as Epic settlement withdrawn
source_articles.excerpt: With the settlement withdrawn, Google is now bound by the court's full antitrust remedies.
